chunks: From him, from al-Qarawī, from Abān, from Ismāʿīl al-Juʿfī and Ibn Abī Yaʿfūr, from Abī Jaʿfar and Abī ʿAbdillāh عليهما السلام, that they both said:
If you do not know whether you have prayed one rakʿah or two, then begin again.

key_terms.لَمْ تَدْرِ: you do not know or are uncertain

ai.seo_question: What should one do if one doubts whether one has prayed one rakʿah or two in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about doubt in the first two rakʿahs of salat (prayer). If a person is uncertain whether he has prayed one or two rakʿahs, he must restart the prayer.
